description: This file defines types, constants, and interfaces used in the Kubernetes scheduler framework, including resource change actions, cluster events, node information, pod scheduling info, affinity terms, resource collections, image summaries, network port configurations, and host port management.

classes.name: ImageStateSummary
classes.description: Provides summarized information about the state of an image, including size, number of nodes hosting the image, and the set of node names.

classes.name: PodResource
classes.description: Contains the result of resource calculation for a pod, including resource quantities and non-zero CPU/memory requests.

classes.name: AffinityTerm
classes.description: Represents a processed version of pod affinity/anti-affinity terms, including namespace sets, label selectors, topology key, and namespace selector.

classes.name: WeightedAffinityTerm
classes.description: Extends AffinityTerm with an associated weight for affinity scoring.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Interface representing a collection of compute resources, with methods to get CPU, memory, storage, allowed pod number, scalar resources, and to set maximum resources.

classes.name: ProtocolPort
classes.description: Represents a network protocol and port pair, e.g., TCP:80.

classes.name: HostPortInfo
classes.description: Maps IP addresses to sets of ProtocolPort, with methods to add, remove, check conflicts, and get length.

methods.name: ActionType.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ActionType value.

methods.name: ClusterEvent.Label
methods.description: Returns a label string for logging and metrics, using CustomLabel if set, otherwise resource and action type.

methods.name: GetAffinityTerms
methods.description: Extracts required scheduling affinity terms from a Pod's affinity configuration.

methods.name: newAffinityTerm
methods.description: Creates an AffinityTerm from a Pod and a PodAffinityTerm, converting label selectors and namespace info.

methods.name: getNamespacesFromPodAffinityTerm
methods.description: Returns a set of namespace names based on a PodAffinityTerm, defaulting to the Pod's namespace if none specified.

methods.name: GetPodAffinityTerms
methods.description: Retrieves required PodAffinityTerms from a Pod's affinity configuration.

methods.name: GetWeightedAffinityTerms
methods.description: Converts weighted Pod affinity terms into internal representation with weights.

methods.name: GetPodAntiAffinityTerms
methods.description: Retrieves required PodAntiAffinityTerms from a Pod's affinity configuration.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a copy of ImageStateSummary without the Nodes set.

methods.name: NewProtocolPort
methods.description: Creates a ProtocolPort with specified protocol and port, defaulting to TCP if protocol is empty.

methods.name: HostPortInfo.Add
methods.description: Adds an IP, protocol, and port to the HostPortInfo mapping.

methods.name: HostPortInfo.Remove
methods.description: Removes an IP, protocol, and port from the HostPortInfo mapping.

methods.name: HostPortInfo.Len
methods.description: Returns total count of IP-protocol-port tuples stored.

methods.name: HostPortInfo.CheckConflict
methods.description: Checks if a given IP, protocol, and port conflicts with existing entries, considering wildcard IP.

methods.name: HostPortInfo.sanitize
methods.description: Ensures IP and protocol are set to default values if empty.
